The plate looks like a small paper plate (about 9 inches across, or roughly 20 cm). It holds sliced sausage, probably smoked sausage or kielbasa, in about 12 pieces of varying size.

Estimated mass: each coin is about 3 cm across and 1.5 cm thick, which is roughly 10 g. Twelve to fourteen pieces, some of them larger, comes to about 130 g.

Smoked sausage runs about 300 kcal per 100 g, so 130 g is roughly 390 kcal.
